fusions.name: Press-Tooth Slam
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 36 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Rivet
fusions.desc: Fires a rivet that deals 9 damage. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cold Clasp
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 8 seconds, hardening your armour by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Tempered Springs
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.
